acceptance.threshold_selection: Fixed DeepSlide default; not tuned on this dataset.

label_method.presence: USGS v3 inventory POINT buffered to 40 m radius as positive pixels inside 128x128@10m chip centered on the point
label_method.absence: Feature-stack pseudo-absence metadata points (min separation already applied in project catalog) with all-zero masks
label_method.limitation: Point inventories are not scar polygons; pixel metrics vs circular buffers are approximate. Chip-level detection is the primary metric.

geography.independence_basis: USGS CONUS points are outside documented L4S Asia study areas

split.method: spatial 5-degree blocks; hold out entire blocks for evaluation only (no training/tuning)

acceptance.chip_positive_rule: chip labelled positive if inventory presence; prediction positive if any pixel score>0.5 inside the 40m buffer (presence) or anywhere (absence → FP if any)
acceptance.secondary_pixel_metrics: reported vs buffer masks but do not alone determine PASS/FAIL
acceptance.scientific_validation_claim: Even if numeric gates pass, results remain limited by point-buffer labels and are NOT full scar-level scientific validation.

limitations: USGS points buffered to 40 m are not landslide scar polygons
Copernicus DEM used instead of ALOS PALSAR
Sentinel-2 L2A B10 zero-filled when absent
Temporal match is nearest low-cloud scene in a window around inventory date, not guaranteed event-day imagery
In-block absences may be catalog pseudo-absences or synthesized (≥5 km from USGS presence); not field-verified non-landslides
Uncalibrated scores are not risk probabilities
Per-block tags are true geographic 5° cells; absences are co-located in the same block as paired presence chips
